name: Slush Pop | Melted Diamond Live Resin Vaporizer | 1.0g (Reload)
description: DIAMONDS INSIDE Our live resin diamonds, extracted from fresh frozen flowers, use a gradual separation process creating large faceted diamond-like crystals. The 99%+ potency diamond crystals are then liquefied, producing the highest potency vaporizers on the market. SLUSH POP Slush Pop bursts with icy cherry, citrus, and blue raspberry flavor for a nostalgic, refreshing experience. This fun vape delivers a cool, sweet hit reminiscent of a summer popsicle, making it a perfect grab for any time you want a playful, flavorful escape.
